DILRMP 3.0 (2026–2031): Bhu-Aadhaar, GIS Land Records, NAKSHA and Key Features

2026-09-14 StudyIQ DILRMP 3.0, India, GIS, land records, Bhu-Aadhaar, ULPIN, NAKSHA, cadastral maps, land governance, digital transformation
Read the source article

Quick summary

India's Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme enters its third phase (2026–2031), creating an integrated GIS-enabled land administration system with unique parcel identification numbers, paperless registration, and cadastral mapping.

Key takeaways

  • DILRMP 3.0 (2026–2031) is the third phase of India's land-records modernisation programme
  • The programme creates an integrated, GIS-enabled, and interoperable land administration system
  • Bhu-Aadhaar (ULPIN) provides every geo-referenced land parcel with a 14-digit Unique Land Parcel Identification Number
  • GIS and cadastral maps are central to the programme's approach
  • NAKSHA scheme supports land survey modernisation
  • The programme includes paperless registration and integrated revenue courts
  • DILRMP 3.0 shifts from digitising records to creating an integrated digital land-governance ecosystem
